---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new behavior or improvement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "The
exercise engine never reports a partial-credit score, so a learner
who writes a correct query with the wrong column order gets the
same feedback as a learner who wrote nonsense."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you considered? Why is this one better?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Tests added (vitest + axe-core smoke)
- [ ] i18n keys added to `es`, `ca`, `en`
- [ ] Roadmap phase updated

## Out of scope

What should *not* be done as part of this change?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to similar features, references to the
roadmap phase, etc.
